simple.summary: בִּזְתָא (Bizthâʼ) means Biztha , a eunuch of Xerxes First listed occurrence: Esth 1 10.

definitions.full: H968. Bizzetha בִּזְּתָא proper name, masculine a eunuch of Ahasuerus , Est 1:10 (Thes compare Persian beste , ligatus sc. membro , e.g. spado , compare Vullers Dict. Pers. below ).
